title: A Archive for the Gravity
author: Ivo Blackwood
blurb: Wren Reyes, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
